title: Business Return-Reason Relief
content:
**Relief by reason.** Under the Business return reversal schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the return reason on the return record on Northgate Store and Online Orders adds to the relief fraction of the reversal:

- a return with reason wrong item or damaged in transit adds **0.2**;
- a return with reason defective or not as described adds **0.1**;
- a return with any other reason adds nothing.

| Reason recorded | Added |
|---|---|
| wrong item | 0.2 |
| damaged in transit | 0.2 |
| defective | 0.1 |
| not as described | 0.1 |
| other | nothing |
